scripts.text:
[Noyee]
Did you know that there's a difference between the armor you can buy from NPC shops and the kinds you obtain from hunting monsters?
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
你知道吗？从NPC商店购买的防具，和通过狩猎魔物获得的防具，其实是有区别的。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
The difference, my friend, is in the number of ^3355FFslots^000000 in your armor.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
朋友，区别就在于防具上的^3355FF插槽^000000数量。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
The same kind of Armor will have the same Defense. However, if an Armor has a slot, you can insert a Monster Card which will add an enhancement to that armor.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
同一种防具，防御力都是一样的。
不过，带孔的防具可以插入魔物卡片，获得额外效果。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
Both Monster Cards and Slotted Armors are rarely dropped by monsters, and are thus valuable commodies.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
魔物卡片和带插槽的防具都很少从魔物身上掉落，因此是非常珍贵的商品。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
You know, there's a very interesting place that looks
sort of like a laboratory in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
你知道吗，在朱诺有一个非常有趣的地方，看起来有点像实验室。

scripts.text:
[Noyee]
Anyway, no one is really sure if it is or not. Recently, it's been the focus of many rumors. I have no idea if any of them are true though.
scripts.translation:
[诺伊]
总之，没人能确定它到底是不是实验室。最近，它成了许多传闻的焦点。不过，我也不知道这些传闻里有没有真的。

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can't believe how busy I am at work nowadays. I don't even have time to see any of my friends or go shopping.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
最近工作忙得不可开交，连见朋友、逛逛街的时间都没了。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Wait...!
I can't even remember the last
time I went out with a guy! At this rate, I might retire before I can find a boyfriend. Noooo, I'm still in my prime~!
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
等等...！
我都不记得上次跟男人约会是什么时候了！
这样下去，怕是退休了都找不到男朋友。
不要啊，我可还青春正好呢~！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
We conduct research on godly artifacts that were left behind by the gods long ago. More specifically, we're interested in the tools the gods used.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
我们研究的是远古时众神遗留下来的神器。
具体来说，就是神明用过的器具。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Recently, many of the members of our research group, aside from the leaders, have left so now we're short on manpower.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
最近，除了负责人，研究组走了不少人，如今人手严重不足。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Since we're understaffed, we can't continue most of our research projects that are currently in progress. Speaking of which...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
由于人手不足，我们无法继续目前正在进行的大多数研究项目。说到这个...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Do you mind if I ask
an adventurer like yourself
to help us in our research?
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
能请像你这样的冒险者帮助我们进行研究吗？

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
We won't experiment on you or anything, we just need you to run some simple errands. And of course, you will be rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
放心，不会拿你做实验，只是帮忙跑跑腿。
当然，也会有报酬。

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy...
scripts.translation: 我有点忙...

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 好啊，没问题

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Oh, I see.
Well, if you happen to find anyone that might work well as a temporary research assistant, would you recommend them to us?
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
哦，我明白了。
那么，如果你恰好发现有人可能很适合做临时研究助手，你会推荐给我们吗？

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I'm so sorry to ask this of you, but I hope you understand that we're seriously lacking in terms
of human resources.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
这样麻烦你，实在不好意思，不过我们实在太缺人了，还请体谅。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Really~?!
That's great!
Hahahahaha! I'm so
glad to hear that!
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
真的~？！
太好了！
哈哈哈哈哈！
你肯答应，实在太高兴了！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Go inside and speak to the investigators there. They're all kind of swamped, so I'm sure they'll need your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
进去找里面的研究员吧。
他们都忙得团团转，肯定需要帮手。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Oh, wait...
Let me give you a temporary admission pass. Thank you
so much for your help~
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
哦，等等...
让我给你一张临时通行证。非常感谢你的帮助~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've received
a temporary
admission pass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了一张临时通行证。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
It's really difficult to managing a laboratory. Rival labs always try to entice our staff away or interrupt our progress.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
管理实验室真的很难。竞争对手总是试图挖走我们的职员，或者干扰我们的研究进度。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
And because of this job, it's really hard for me to enjoy
having a personal life...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
也因为这份工作，我连自己的生活都顾不上了...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Hahahaha...
What am I doing?
Please just ignore what I just said. It's really not that big of a deal. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
哈哈哈哈...
我这是在干什么呢？
刚才的话别放在心上，其实也没多大事。
^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, thank you
for helping us out.
I hope you'll continue
to lend us your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
啊，谢谢你帮助我们。
希望你能继续支持我们。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Although our researchers are kind of strange, they're all pretty nice and they mean well.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
虽然我们的研究员有点古怪，但他们都很友善，而且心地善良。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
So I hope you understand if a few of them treat you in a way that seems kind of rude.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
所以如果其中几个人对待你的方式显得有些无礼，希望你能理解。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah...
You really helped us out a lot. Thank you for all you have done.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
啊...
你真的帮了我们大忙。谢谢你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
As you already know, we're trying to find out whether or not we can reproduce 'Sleipnir,' one of the tools used by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
你也知道，我们想弄清楚，能否重现众神用过的神器“史雷普尼尔之靴”。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
However....
So far it seems impossible, at least with the technology that we currently have. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
不过...至少凭现有技术，目前看来还做不到。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Anyways, we will continue to research and hope that we'll be able to accomplish our goal of recreating Sleipnir someday.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
总之，研究会继续下去，希望有朝一日能重现史雷普尼尔之靴。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Thanks to you, we were able to complete a rudimentary study of Sleipnir. Now we can plan out a more advanced study of Sleipnir.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
多亏你帮忙，我们完成了史雷普尼尔之靴的初步研究。
接下来，就能规划更深入的研究了。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Before I forget, let me give you your reward for assisting in our research projects. Please give
me a minute...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
对了，差点忘了给你协助研究的报酬。
请稍等...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, there it is.
It might not be much, but I hope you accept it as a token of my gratitude. Good luck on your travels!
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
啊，在这里。
这可能不算什么，但我希望你能收下它作为我的一点心意。祝你旅途顺利！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, I'll also need to take back that temporary pass I gave to you. I'm sorry, but it's protocol we have to follow...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
啊，我还需要收回之前给你的临时通行证。很抱歉，这是我们必须遵守的规定...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Once again,
thank you for
all your help~
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
再次感谢你的所有帮助~

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
With your assistance, we successfully completed our rudimentary study.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
在你的协助下，我们成功完成了初步研究。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
From now on, we'll plan out our more advanced studies based on the information we now have on the godly artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
接下来，我们会根据现有的神器资料，规划更深入的研究。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Now that things
have slowed down
a little...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
现在总算没那么忙了...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can finally
go on a date!
Hahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
终于可以去约会了！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can't believe how busy I am at work nowadays. I don't even have time to see any of my friends or go shopping.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
最近工作忙得不可开交，连见朋友、逛逛街的时间都没了。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Wait...!
I can't even remember the last
time I went out with a guy! At this rate, I might retire before I can find a boyfriend. Noooo, I'm still in my prime~!
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
等等...！
我都不记得上次跟男人约会是什么时候了！
这样下去，怕是退休了都找不到男朋友。
不要啊，我可还青春正好呢~！

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Ah, you've come back.
I know you were going to help us, but someone already applied for the assistant position.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
啊，你回来了。
我知道你本来打算帮助我们，但已经有人申请了助手的职位。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Anyway, we've already finished our current research projects. Now, we're in the planning stages for the next projects we'll be conducting...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
总之，我们已经完成了目前的研究项目。现在，我们正在规划下一阶段的研究...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Thank you anyway, though. I hope you will come and help us the next time we need assistance on our projects.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
不过还是要谢谢你。希望下次我们需要协助时，你能再来帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Now that we've completed our rudimentary studies, we'll simply plan out our future research projects.
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
既然我们已经完成了基础研究，接下来就只需规划未来的研究项目了。

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
Now that things
have slowed down
a little...
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
现在总算没那么忙了...

scripts.text:
[Cukure]
I can finally
go on a date!
Hahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[库库雷]
终于可以去约会了！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Ah, are you the one whom Ms. Kirin referred? Yes, she said you were going to help me in my research.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
啊，你是麒麟小姐介绍来的那位吗？是的，她说你会来协助我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Frankly, we don't really need anyone who doesn't specialize
in our field of study.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
坦白说，不是这个领域的专业人士，我们其实用不上。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
But if you don't mind helping us out by doing little, menial tasks, then it'd probably bring some relief to our workload.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
不过，你若不介意做些琐碎杂务，多少也能减轻我们的负担。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Now...
What would be
a good job for you?
Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
那么...
什么工作适合你呢？
让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I got it!
Why don't you go and visit ^FF0000Metto^000000 for me? Please bring me any news that he'd like to report.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
有了！
替我去见见^FF0000梅托^000000吧？
问问他有没有什么研究消息，再回来告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Since he's working on a project similar to mine, he might be in a position to help me. Metto lives in Juno, so you can easily find me.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
因为他正在做和我类似的项目，也许他能帮上忙。梅托住在朱诺，你应该很容易找到他。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I guess you haven't found Metto yet. Although he might be a little over enthusiastic at times, he's not a bad guy at all.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
看来你还没找到梅托。虽然他有时候有点过于热情，但他其实是个不错的人。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
We've been friends for a long time after working in the same field for so long. I wonder how he's doing?
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
做了这么多年的同行，我们也早成了朋友。
不知道他近来怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Anyway, just ask him about any progress on his research. And if he happens to ask you for help, please lend him your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
总之，问问他研究的进展吧。如果他恰好需要帮助，请尽量协助他。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Hmmm...
So how's Metto?
Hmm? It seems like
he has changed...
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
嗯...
梅托怎么样了？
嗯？看来他变了...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Hmmm...
So how's Metto?
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
嗯...
梅托怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
A mad scientist?
That doesn't sound right. In my wildest dreams, I never would have suspected Metto of turning out that way...
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
疯狂科学家？
不应该啊。
做梦也想不到，梅托居然会变成这样...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Huh. That's...
That's too bad. I don't know what to say. We used to go watch movies and celebrate our birthdays together. P-please give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
啊，这...太遗憾了。
我都不知道该说什么。
以前我们还一起看电影、庆祝生日呢。
请、请让我缓一缓...

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Ah...
You came back.
Alright, let me give you the gist of what I'm researching.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
啊...
你回来了。
好吧，让我给你讲讲我正在研究的内容。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I'm trying to learn more about the '^FF0000Wheel of the Unknown^000000,' which was discovered to be a piece of the artifact known as ^FF0000Sleipnir^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
我研究的是“^FF0000未知的锯齿轮子^000000”。
已经发现，它是神器^FF0000史雷普尼尔之靴^000000的一个部件。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
It looks like
a normal cogwheel...
But I can't figure out how it's supposed to work.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
它看起来像普通的齿轮...
但我搞不清楚它是怎么运作的。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
The most peculiar thing of all about this cogwheel is the metal
of which it is composed.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
这个齿轮最特别的地方，在于构成它的金属材质。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
It looks and feels like steel,but extreme heat and cold don't affect it. It also cannot be dented by any kind of impact or force I can apply to it.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
看着、摸着都像钢铁，极热极寒却都奈何不了它。
不管我用多大力气，怎么撞击，都留不下半点凹痕。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Sometimes, I find that the Wheel of the Unknown resonates with certain objects, but I haven't got it to occur all of the time.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
我发现未知的锯齿轮子有时会与某些物体共鸣，可惜还不能稳定重现这种现象。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
I'm guessing that I'm missing some sort of special condition that will make the Wheel of the Unknown resonate with specific materials.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
想让未知的锯齿轮子与特定材料共鸣，似乎还缺少某种特殊条件。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Anyway, I thank you for helping me out earlier. That's basically all I needed, so please talk to the other researchers and see if they need any assistance.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
总之，非常感谢你之前的帮助。我基本上已经得到我需要的信息了，所以请去和其他研究员谈谈，看看他们是否需要协助。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Oh, sorry.
I'm quite busy compiling all of this information at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
哦，抱歉。
我现在正忙着整理所有的资料。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Let's see...
Now how would I...
^333333*Mumble mumble*^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
让我看看...
那么我该怎么做呢...
^333333*嘟嘟囔囔*^000000

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Hmmm...
How does this work?
There's still too much we don't know about the godly artifacts. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
嗯...
这东西是怎么运作的？
关于神器，我们仍然有太多不了解的地方。^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
It's not easy, working on this alone. Having an extra pair of hands is always good.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
一个人研究，确实不容易。
能有人搭把手总是好的。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Right now, I just need someone with whom I can share the workload. Still, different assistants might be better depending on the project.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
目前，我只需要一个能分担工作的人。不过，根据项目的不同，合适的助手可能也会有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Basically, if an assistant is especially trained in the field related to my current research project, he'll probably be more useful than someone who's not.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
基本上，如果助手在我当前研究项目的相关领域受过专门训练，他可能比没有相关背景的人更有用。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Of course, there are people who are good at everything. But since those are rare, I try to choose just the right assistant for each of my projects.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
当然，也有样样精通的人。但既然这种人很少见，我会努力为每个项目挑选最合适的助手。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
It's not easy, working on this alone. Having an extra pair of hands is always good.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
一个人研究，确实不容易。
能有人搭把手总是好的。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Right now, I just need someone with whom I can share the workload. Still, different assistants might be better depending on the project.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
目前，我只需要一个能分担工作的人。不过，根据项目的不同，合适的助手可能也会有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Hallandaute]
Basically, if an assistant is especially trained in the field related to my current research project, he'll probably be more useful than someone who's not.
scripts.translation:
[哈兰道特]
基本上，如果助手在我当前研究项目的相关领域受过专门训练，他可能比没有相关背景的人更有用。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Right now, I'm
focusing on studying
the background story of this feather, as well as how it came
to be a material for a godly artifact.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
目前，我正专注于研究这根羽毛的背景故事，以及它是如何成为神器材料的。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
I was recently told that there is a person in Payon who actually knows this story. Very few people in the world are privy to having such knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]

世上知道其中详情的人，可是少之又少。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Now, we don't have enough
staff for me to send someone to Payon. Also, I don't feel safe taking this feather around with me.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
现在，我们没有足够的人手让我派人去斐扬。而且，我也不觉得带着这根羽毛到处走很安全。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
It shouldn't be that difficult to find the person who knows about Sleipnir's origin. However, you must memorize every single
word of the story.
scripts.translation:

知道史雷普尼尔起源的人，应该不难找。
不过，故事中的每一句话，都得牢记。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
The results of this research could be affected by the words you deliver to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
你传达给我的话语，可能会影响这项研究的结果。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Thank you for the trouble.
There's no real time limit for this task, but the sooner you complete it, the better.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
辛苦你了。
这个任务没有严格的时间限制，但越快完成越好。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Have a safe trip~
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
一路顺风~

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Mmm...?
You haven't left for Payon yet to find the man who knows of Sleipnir's origin?
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
嗯...？
你还没去斐扬找那个知道史雷普尼尔起源的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Please leave for
Payon as soon as
possible so that I can get the information that I need for my research. Thank you, and have
a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
请尽快前往斐扬，这样我才能拿到研究所需的信息。
谢谢，一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Ah, you're back. So have you memorized the story?
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
啊，你回来了。
那么，故事记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
I know it'd be much easier if this tale was already written, but you must understand that many stories regarding the gods are only orally transmitted.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
要是有文字记录，当然方便得多。
可你也要知道，许多关于神的故事，都只靠口耳相传。

I'm listening.

know what you've learned.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
好的，我在听。
请告诉我你了解到的内容。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]
Hmm, I see.
Fascinating.
However, I'm sure
you've missed some
important detail.
scripts.translation:
[阿丁]
嗯，我明白了。
很有趣。
不过，我确信你遗漏了某些重要的细节。

scripts.text:
[Aadin]

complete story.

[阿丁]
嗯，不对，等等...

是我弄错了，抱歉~

Surely, I'll be able to answer some of my most important questions with the information you've brought to me, though it still won't be easy.

Sometimes, different versions of the same myth or legend arise.

[阿丁]

[Kurdt]
Ah, you must be
the new assistant.
Pleased to meet you.

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
In all honesty, I was expecting someone with a bit more experience in the field of research, but it's understandable.

[库尔特]

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]

不过，我相信你能给研究带来新的视角。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
I've almost completed my project and don't need too much in the way of manpower. However, the last task I need finished is difficult.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]

scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
本来想自己出钱，请外面的人帮忙。
既然你来了，这钱就能省下了~

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
What I'd like to ask you to do is to gather materials so that I can create the 'Spirit of Fish.'
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
我想请你收集一些材料，以便我制作“鱼的灵魂”。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
I'm not sure if I can actually produce it or not, but we can at least give this experiment a try.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
我不确定是否真的能制作出来，但至少我们可以尝试一下这个实验。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Basically, you and collect things like 'Fish Scales' or Fish Tails,' basically anything you can obtain from marine life.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
你可以收集鱼鳞、鱼尾之类的东西，总之，海洋生物身上取得的材料都行。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
I don't need a
ridiculous amount of one
kind of material, I'd say about 10 of one kind of each item should work. Give or take 5...

[库尔特]
每种材料不用多得离谱，大概10个就够了。
上下差5个左右也行...

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
I should mention that I also require a good variety of marine related materials. You can't conduct an experiment without different objects to test, right?
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
我应该提一下，我还需要种类丰富的海洋相关材料。没有不同的测试对象，是无法进行实验的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Anyway, I hope you don't run into too much trouble finding what I need for this experiment. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
总之，希望你在寻找实验所需材料时不会遇到太多麻烦。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Ah, you've returned.
Okay, let me check
what you brought to me. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
啊，你回来了。
好的，让我看看你带来了什么。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Ooh...
I could use these.
And these too. Oh!
You adventurers carry
a lot of things, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
哦...这些能用，这些也能用。
哎呀，你们冒险者身上的东西可真不少！

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Ah....!
The materials you have should be enough for me to conduct my experiment. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
啊...！
这些材料应该够做实验了。
太感谢了。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
With these, I can continue my research without any problem. I'm pleasantly surprised with the job you've done.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
有了这些，研究就能顺利继续了。
你干得这么好，真让我惊喜。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
You really were
such a great help.
Thank you so much!
Hahaha....!
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
真是帮了大忙，太感谢了！
哈哈哈...！

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Now, there may be
other researchers
who might need your help in completing their projects. Why don't you ask around to see if
they need anything?
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
现在，可能还有其他研究员需要你的帮助来完成他们的项目。你不妨四处问问，看看他们是否需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Still, you don't seem to have enough materials for me to
complete my research
Remember, I need
a huge variety.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
不过，你似乎还没有足够的材料让我完成研究。
记住，我需要种类繁多的材料。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
I'm sorry for the hassle, but do you think you could go out and collect things so that I can attempt to recreate the
'Spirit of Fish?'
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Hmmm....
Funds and
manpower are
important for
research to progress.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
嗯...
资金和人力对于研究的推进至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
But no amount of financing or staffing can replace the value of enthusiasm and passion in conducting research.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
不过，钱再多，人再多，也抵不过研究者自身的热情。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
Some financiers are so ignorant that they think that if they throw more money and people into a project, the secrets of science will be unlocked that much faster.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
有些资助者非常无知，他们认为只要往项目里投入更多的钱和人，就能更快地揭开科学的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Kurdt]
But if the people doing your research are unmotivated and uninspired, you'll never get anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[库尔特]
可研究的人要是没有干劲和灵感，再怎么做也不会有进展。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
No matter how old the stories are, you can always find good advice in folk tales and legends.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
无论故事多么古老，你总能从民间传说和传奇中找到有益的建议。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Despite the passing of time and mankind's progression, certain fundamentals of life are timeless and will never change.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
尽管时光流逝，人类不断进步，但某些生活的基本准则是永恒的，永远不会改变。

scripts.text: Umm...
I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Hmm...?
Do you need
anything from me?
I will try to help
you as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
嗯...？
你需要我帮忙吗？
我会尽力帮助你的。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I believe that it's no use having ability or power unless you use that power for the right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我相信，如果不用能力或力量去做正确的事，那么拥有它们就没有意义。

scripts.text: Oh no, that's okay.
scripts.translation: 不，不用了

scripts.text: Sleipnir's story.
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼尔的故事

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I must have
misunderstood me.
However, feel free
to ask me for help
if you ever need it.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
看来是我误会了。
不过，如果你需要帮助，随时可以找我。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I consider helping others as special training for my spiritual improvement. I hope that you will act with kindness and generosity towards others as well.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我把帮助他人，当成修养心性的特别训练。
也希望你能怀着善意，慷慨地对待别人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah, I see.
I can tell you what I know about Sleipnir. Let's see now if I can remember everything about it.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
啊，我明白了。
我可以告诉你我所知道的关于史雷普尼尔的事。让我想想，看能不能回忆起所有细节。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah yes.
I remember it now.
Yes, Sleipnir was the
name of Odin's stallion.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
啊，是的。
我想起来了。
是的，史雷普尼尔是奥丁的坐骑。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In the world of
gods, there were
three legendary stallions: Sleipnir, Svadilfari and Gullfaxi.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
在神界，有三匹传奇的骏马：史雷普尼尔、斯瓦迪尔法里和古尔法克西。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Gullfaxi was owned by Hrungnir, the king of the giants. Svadilfari, the stallion that sired Sleipnir, was also owned by a giant.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
古尔法克西属于巨人王赫鲁格尼尔。而史雷普尼尔的父亲斯瓦迪尔法里，也属于一位巨人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay, now let's talk about how 'Sleipnir' was born. This story gives us a glimpse of the fallibility of gods and giants.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
接下来，就讲讲史雷普尼尔是怎么诞生的。
从这个故事，也能看出神和巨人同样会犯错。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In Asgard, the realm of the gods, there was a huge protective rampart that was almost completely destroyed in a recent war.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
神域阿斯加德本有一道巨大的城墙，却在不久前的战争中几乎全毁。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
However...
Gods being gods,
they were not eager
to rebuild the walls
themselves.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
不过...神毕竟是神，谁也不愿意亲手重建城墙。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
One day, a very
skinny man rode on
a dark horse and offered to rebuild, and even improve, the rampart protecting Asgard.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
有一天，一个非常瘦弱的男人骑着一匹黑马出现，提出愿意重建甚至改进保护阿斯加德的城墙。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
His offer was tempting to the gods, who needed every protection from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
众神正需要抵御敌人的防护，这个提议自然很诱人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
This man promised to rebuild
the Asgardian rampart in only 18 months, but in return he wanted the goddess Freya as his wife, as well as ownership of the sun and the moon.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
这个男人承诺在18个月内重建阿斯加德的城墙，但作为回报，他要求娶女神芙蕾雅为妻，并拥有太阳和月亮。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Now, this price was unreasonable for the gods to pay. The Asgardians were all insulted and angered by the stranger's demands. Still, they did want their rampart to be rebuilt.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
可这代价实在太过分了。
众神都觉得受了羞辱，对陌生人的要求十分愤怒。
然而，他们又确实想修复城墙。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, we can
finish this
story later.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
...
觉得无聊了吗？
要是累了，我们下次再讲。

scripts.text: Yeah, let's finish this later.
scripts.translation: 是的，稍后再讲吧

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I understand that my story was not that interesting. But I will try my best to entertain you next time. Please travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
看来我的故事没那么有趣。
下次我会尽量讲得生动些，一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh alright.
Then let me continue.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
哦，好的。
那我继续讲。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The gods were furious with the stranger's ridiculous demands. However, Loki proposed to Odin
that they should let the stranger rebuild their defensive walls.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
众神都为陌生人的无理要求而愤怒，洛基却向奥丁提议，让他来修城墙。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Loki suggested that if the stranger could complete most of the rampart renovation, but later than as agreed, the gods would not be obligated to pay the stranger any price.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
洛基的意思是，让陌生人完成大部分工程，只要没能如期完工，众神就什么也不用付。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Odin decided to follow Loki's advice, and told the stranger that the wall must be repaired in 6 months, instead of 18 months as the stranger had proposed. He could receive help from no man.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
奥丁决定采纳洛基的建议，并告诉陌生人，城墙必须在6个月内修好，而不是他提议的18个月。他不能得到任何人的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In return, the stranger would be paid as he had asked if he could fulfill those conditions. Since he was just a man, it seemed impossible.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
要是完成这些条件，众神就按他的要求付酬。
他看着不过是个凡人，似乎根本不可能做到。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Hmmm...
I know this story is quite long. Did you want to listen some more, or did you need a break?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
嗯...
我知道这个故事挺长的。你想继续听，还是需要休息一下？

scripts.text: Let me take down some notes first.
scripts.translation: 让我先记点笔记

scripts.text: I need a break!
scripts.translation: 我需要休息一下！

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah....
I understand this story is quite long. My apologies. Alright, I'll wait for you to finish writing your notes.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
啊...故事确实有些长，抱歉。
好，我等你记完笔记。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
May I continue the story now?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我可以继续讲故事了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay, now
where was I?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
好的，我刚才讲到哪了？

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I understand that the tale of Sleipnir is pretty long. But if you have the patience, I will try to relate this story to you another time. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
史雷普尼尔的故事，的确很长。
等你有耐心听了，我再慢慢讲给你听。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh good.
Then please let me continue.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
哦，太好了。
那请让我继续。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Now, the stranger insisted that he be able to use his horse to help him do this reconstruction work. Since the horse was rather plain and simple looking, Odin agreed.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
接着，那个陌生人坚持要用他的马来帮助完成这项重建工作。因为这匹马看起来相当普通，奥丁便答应了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Odin didn't think
twice about his
request, and regretted this decision upon observing the stranger's first day of rebuilding the rampart.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
奥丁没有多想就答应了他的请求，直到看到陌生人重建城墙的第一天，他才后悔了这个决定。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Strangely enough, the stranger, using his horse to carry the materials, rebuilt the rampart at a speed that was inhuman.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
不可思议的是，他让马运送材料，修墙的速度快得根本不像人类。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
This upset the gods, since the stranger was actually a mighty giant in disguise. However, this did not violate their agreement,
so the gods could do nothing.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
这让众神感到不安，因为那个陌生人实际上是一个伪装起来的强大巨人。然而，这并没有违反他们的约定，所以众神无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Although the stranger's skills were great, his horse greatly sped up the rampart reconstruction. This was the legendary magical horse, Svadilfari.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
虽然陌生人的技艺高超，但他的马极大地加快了城墙的重建速度。这匹传奇的魔法马名叫斯瓦迪尔法里。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The gods grew more anxious as the wall would soon be completed before the alloted six months were up. The Asgardians soon grew very angry with Loki.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
眼看六个月还没到，城墙就要完工，众神越来越焦急，纷纷迁怒于洛基。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Despite this, Loki remained calm and assured the gods that he had a plan. The gods distrusted his craftiness, and grew desperate as the stranger's work speedily progressed.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
洛基却依然镇定，向众神保证自有办法。
众神信不过他这狡猾家伙，眼看工程进展飞快，愈发绝望。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Then, the reconstruction of the rampart suddenly halted. Both the gods and the stranger were equally surprised, as the horse Svadilfari was now missing.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
就在这时，修墙的工作突然停了。
众神和陌生人都大吃一惊：斯瓦迪尔法里竟不见了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The stranger would
now need to continue
his work by himself.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
现在，陌生人只能独自继续他的工作了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Hmmm...
Are you still listening? If you're tired, I understand and we can
stop for now.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
嗯...
你还在听吗？如果你累了，我理解，我们可以先停一下。

scripts.text: I'm so exhausted!
scripts.translation: 我太累了！

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I know that this story might seem too long. But if you ever want to sit down and hear it again, I'll be glad to go over it again. Thank you for listening, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我知道这个故事可能显得太长了。但如果你以后想坐下来再听一遍，我很乐意再讲一次。谢谢你听我讲，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh alright,
I'll go on then.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
哦，好的，那我继续了。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In their curiosity, the gods decided to investigate Savdilfari's disappearance.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
出于好奇，众神决定调查斯瓦迪尔法里失踪的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Surprisingly,
they found that
Svadilfari fell in love with a beautiful mare, which was why
it did not work on the rampart.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
令人惊讶的是，他们发现斯瓦迪尔法里爱上了一匹美丽的母马，这就是它没有继续修建城墙的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
So when the 6 months passed, the stranger almost finished rebuilding the Asgardian walls. Only the castle gate was left untouched.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
所以，当六个月期限过去时，陌生人几乎完成了阿斯加德城墙的重建。只剩下城堡大门还没有动工。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The gods were happy to tell the stranger that they could not pay him what he requested, since he did not complete the rampart as originally agreed.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
由于没有按约定完工，众神便高高兴兴地告诉陌生人，不能付给他要求的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In his rage, the stranger accused the gods of tricking him so that they would not have to pay him with the sun, the moon and the beautiful goddess Freya. Then, he revealed his true identity.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
陌生人勃然大怒，指责众神使诈，就是不想交出太阳、月亮和美丽的芙蕾雅女神。
随后，他现出了真身。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
He was a
terrible frost giant,
or Hrimthurs as they say.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
他是一个可怕的霜巨人，也就是他们所说的赫里姆瑟斯。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, we can
talk about this
later you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
...
觉得无聊了吗？
要是这样，我们以后再聊。

scripts.text: I'm so bored~
scripts.translation: 好无聊啊~

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I see. Well, stories are meant to be enjoyed and I suppose you're not in the mood to sit and listen.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我明白了。故事本来就是用来享受的，看来你现在没有心情坐下来听。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
But if you ever do want to hear about Sleipnir, feel free to visit me once again. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
不过，如果你以后想听关于史雷普尼尔的故事，欢迎随时再来找我。祝你今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh, I'm glad~
Some people would
actually be sleeping
after listening so long~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
哦，我很高兴~
有些人听这么长时间其实早就睡着了~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Anyway...
The stranger turned out
to be a giant training in
stone masonry. Although he was invading Asgard, the gods didn't worry.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
总之...
那个陌生人原来是一个正在练习石工技艺的巨人。虽然他在入侵阿斯加德，但众神并不担心。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Thor quickly killed the giant with his mighty hammer, Mjolnir, by hurling it at the giant's head, which exploded into a thousand pieces.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
托尔立即掷出威力无比的雷神之锤，正中巨人的脑袋，把它打得粉碎，当场杀死了巨人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
As for the horse, Svadilfari, it was nowhere to be found for
a long, long time.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
至于那匹马，斯瓦迪尔法里，在很长很长的时间里都下落不明。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, let's talk
about this later.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
...
觉得无聊了吗？
要是这样，就留到以后再讲吧。

scripts.text: Let me take down some notes.
scripts.translation: 让我记一些笔记

scripts.text: See you later.
scripts.translation: 回头见

scripts.text: No, please go ahead.
scripts.translation: 不，请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Ah....
I see that you really want to keep track of every important detail!
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
啊...
看来你真的想记录下每一个重要的细节！

scripts.text:
[Lania]
My apologies, I'll wait for you to complete your notes then.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
抱歉，我会等你写完笔记的。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
May I continue the story now?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我可以继续讲故事了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 请继续

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay. Hmm...
Now where was I?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
好的。嗯...
我刚才说到哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Oh, I guess my story wasn't really that interesting. But if you want to listen to this story again, please come visit me again.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
哦，我想我的故事可能没那么有趣。但如果你想再听一遍这个故事，请再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay then,
travel safely~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
那么，一路平安~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Okay. Hmm...
Now where was I?
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
好的。嗯...
我刚才说到哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Lania]
After a while, Loki, who looked tattered and worn out, brought a strange looking pony with eight legs to Asgard.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
过了一段时间，洛基衣衫破烂、疲惫不堪地回到了阿斯加德，还带着一匹长了八条腿的怪模怪样的小马。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Loki introduced the pony as 'Sleipnir' and presented it to
Odin as a present.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
洛基将这匹马介绍为“史雷普尼尔”，并将其作为礼物献给了奥丁。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In actuality, Loki transformed into the mare that seduced Svadilfari so that it would no longer work on the rampart.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
实际上，洛基变身为那匹引诱斯瓦迪尔法里的母马，以便它不再继续建造城墙。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
So 'Sleipnir' was born from the legendary mare Svadilfari, and the god Loki who transformed himself into a horse.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
所以，“史雷普尼尔”是由传奇骏马斯瓦迪尔法里和变身为马的神洛基所生。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Now, stories that are spread through word of mouth might have differences in the small details, depending on who's telling the story.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
现在，口口相传的故事可能会因为讲述者的不同而在细节上有所差异。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Still, the fundamental story line should not be different.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
不过，故事的基本脉络应该不会有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I don't usually get to practice storytelling, and I'm not too confident of the authenticity of my version of Sleipnir's tale.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我平时很少练习讲故事，所以我不太确定我讲述的史雷普尼尔的故事是否完全准确。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
But I hope you will understand that I did my best. It was the most that I could do to help you.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
但我希望你能理解，我已经尽力了。这是我为了帮助你所能做的最大努力。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
If you wish to listen to this story again, you're always welcome.
Be safe on your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
如果你想再听一遍这个故事，随时欢迎。
祝你在冒险中平安~

scripts.text:
[Lania]
In times of agony, please reflect on your past to help you find a solution.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
在痛苦迷茫的时候，请回顾过去，这或许能帮你找到解决之道。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Like the old myths and legends, your experiences are stories from which you can learn valuable lessons.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
就像古老的传说一样，你的经历也是故事，从中你可以学到宝贵的教训。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
I told you everything I know. Hopefully, I was of some help to you. Please treat others with the same generosity and kindness.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
我已经告诉了你我所知道的一切。希望这对你有所帮助。请以同样的慷慨和善意对待他人。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Training isn't limited to just physical and mental conditioning.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
训练不仅仅局限于身体和精神的锻炼。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
The way you lead your life and interact with other people can also be considered part of your training.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
如何生活、如何待人接物，也都是修行的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Lania]
Everyone will learn and benefit differently, depending on how they live their day to day lives.
scripts.translation:
[拉尼娅]
过日子的方式不同，从生活里学到的东西、得到的收获，也会不同。
